description: This file implements the ClientController class and related functions for managing client connections, shared memory, and application state transitions within the Rialto client component. It includes methods for registering/unregistering clients, initializing and terminating shared memory, and notifying clients of state changes.

classes.name: ClientController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing client connections, shared memory, and application state within the Rialto client.

classes.name: IClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Singleton accessor class providing access to the ClientController instance.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: getClientController
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton ClientController object.

methods.name: ClientController
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ClientController with a factory for IPC control.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Returns the current shared memory handle.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and retrieves the current application state.

methods.name: initSharedMemory
methods.description: Initializes shared memory by obtaining a handle from the control IPC.

methods.name: termSharedMemory
methods.description: Terminates and resets the shared memory handle.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Updates the application state and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: stateToString
methods.description: Converts an ApplicationState enum to its string representation.

methods.name: changeStateAndNotifyClients
methods.description: Changes the application state and notifies all registered clients.
